title: Isolate one held object from an equipped reference
description: The single weapon or tool a character holds, as a standalone rendering: the hand and everything else removed, occluded areas completed conservatively. Isolate first, then make its plates from this.

body.subject: The first image is the equipped character reference. Isolate its ONE {{item}} as a standalone rendering
body.action: Keep its visible proportions, materials, fittings and wear. Remove the character, the hand and all other equipment; complete the hand-occluded areas conservatively, inventing nothing decorative
body.style: Pure solid #FF00FF background edge to edge, orthographic projection, flat even diffuse lighting from the camera direction, matte materials, minimal specular
body.constraints: One object only; no hand, body, second item, text or watermark

item.description: the held object, e.g. spear, sword, shield

camera.default: The object upright and centred, its broad face toward the camera
camera.description: the framing of the standalone rendering

reference_image.description: the equipped character holding the object

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: the hidden construction is inferred, not recovered: say so when the plates are made from it

provenance.source: astra-1 crew shelf: the TITAN ImageGen workflow (titan-imagegen SKILL.md, 2026-09-26), its templates and encountered failures
provenance.note: generalised from one armour set to any equipment: the wearer-axis camera table, one physical piece per plate, the 3x2 turnaround order at one physical scale, isolation of a held object, and the synthetic-character provenance that cleared an image-service refusal
